##Synopsis##

High pressure covers the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

##State of Sea##

Smooth, becoming slight tonight.


##Weather##

Fair, patchy rain developing tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Mainly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 Tuesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, occasional rain from the east Tuesday afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in rain later.
